question: Do owners approve `skills.securityReview` as the permanent operator-admin pre-install trust contract for native clients?
rationale: The concrete defect is repaired, but creating a shared security API and native third-party-code installation boundary requires explicit product and ownership intent.

options.title: Approve the dedicated RPC
options.body: Keep the method after rebase, contract-description alignment, exact-head proof, and confirmation that preview identity and disposition remain aligned with final installation enforcement.

options.title: Fold review into installation
options.body: Replace the separate preflight method with a server-issued review token or canonical server-owned review-and-install operation.

options.title: Defer Android installation
options.body: Limit this PR to search, filtering, status, and toggles until native installation receives product sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Approve the dedicated RPC
recommendation.body: Keep the method after rebase, contract-description alignment, exact-head proof, and confirmation that preview identity and disposition remain aligned with final installation enforcement.
